description: Encode UTF-8 text to Base64, or decode Base64, with the standard or URL-safe alphabet. Use it for data URIs, HTTP headers or token segments; to read a JWT use jwt_decode. Runs without network access and does not store your input. Input up to 100,000 bytes; larger input is an error. Encode returns base64 and bytes; URL-safe output has no padding. Decode accepts padded or unpadded input and returns text when the bytes are valid UTF-8, otherwise text null plus hex. Invalid Base64 is an error.

data.description: Text or Base64 data, up to 100 KB.

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 0 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

url_safe.description: Use the URL-safe alphabet without padding.

name: base64_convert
